siteTitle: Thrive | Where can you serve? | LOFT City Church

welcome.title: Where can you serve?
welcome.lead: Thrive helps you find where you fit in the life of the church. About four minutes on your phone, and it ends with a real next step, not a reading assignment.
welcome.consent: By continuing, you're okay with a LOFT team leader reaching out about serving.
welcome.note: Answer from your gut, based on what draws you or wears you down, not whether you've been trained. Skills can be taught; passion can't be manufactured.

questions.prompt: Imagine doing each of these regularly. Where do you land?

readiness.title: You scored high on these. Have you done this kind of thing before?

options.label: Yes, and I'm good at it
Some, and I'd like to grow

audience.title: Who are you most drawn to serve?
audience.note: Pick up to three, or skip. This helps us point you to the right people, from our littlest kids to our newest guests.

availability.title: How available are you to serve this season?
availability.note: We ask so we can be mindful of your real capacity. This is discernment, not a guilt trip. If this is a season of rest and healing, we honor that.

results.headline: {name}, you're wired as a {a1} and a {a2}.
results.emerging: {name}, your clearest wiring is as a {a1}, with {a2} emerging.
results.rolesNote: Real roles, real time costs. Tap one to try it once, no commitment beyond a single Sunday.
results.noDrains: No strong drains showed up for you. That's rare and worth noticing.
results.restNote: You told us this is a season of rest and healing. Hear this clearly: that is not a problem to fix. Rest is holy, and the church should be a place where you heal, not a place that uses you. These are seeds for a future season.
results.fullNote: You told us life is very full right now. These fits are chosen to be small and sustainable. Serving should fit inside the margins God gives, not compete with the people already entrusted to you.
results.recalNote: You're already serving and re-evaluating. Good. Re-evaluating is stewardship, not quitting. Talk with your current leader first, and bring this with you.
results.notNow: Not right now, just save my results

confirm.title: You're in.
confirm.body: {leader} leads {team} and will reach out by {day} to set up a first Sunday. Here's what that looks like:
confirm.firstSunday: You'll be met at the door, given one real and small thing to do, introduced to a couple of people by name, and thanked before you leave. That's it. No commitment past that one Sunday.
confirm.introBody: We've emailed you and {leader}, who leads {team}, together. Reply to that email with any question at all. Pastor Sam is copied so nothing falls through the cracks.
confirm.coffeeBody: Pick a time that works for you, in person or on Zoom. We've also emailed you the link and let Sam know to expect you.
confirm.remindBody: We'll check in on {date}, and not before. We've emailed you your report so you have it in the meantime.
confirm.keepBody: Your results are with the LOFT team. Nobody will reach out unless you ask. Come back to any of these doors whenever you're ready.
confirm.error: Something went wrong saving your results. Please show this screen to a table host or email info@loftcity.church.

about.title: Tell us a little about you
about.note: Every one of these is optional. They help your team leader make serving easy, not harder.
about.skillsLabel: Any skills or languages the church should know about?
about.skillsPlaceholder: e.g., nursing, carpentry, bookkeeping, Spanish, video editing
about.barriersLabel: Anything that would make serving hard?
about.rhythmLabel: What kind of rhythm fits you best?
about.faithLabel: Where are you with Jesus right now?
about.faithNote: There's no wrong answer, and nobody is grading. We ask so we can walk with you at the right pace.

report.title: {name}, here's what we learned.
report.sub: Take it, print it, pray over it. Nothing here commits you to anything.
report.emailSent: Sent to {email}. Check your inbox in a minute.
report.emailFail: Couldn't send just now. Try again in a moment, or use Print.
report.fruitfulNote: Where you come alive. Lean in here.
report.faithfulNote: Capable, not energized. Good for a season when there's a need.
report.wearyingNote: Tends to drain you over time. Serve here sparingly.
report.noDrains: No strong drains showed up for you. That's rare and worth noticing.
report.rolesTitle: Roles at LOFT that fit you
report.rolesNote: Based on your wiring, who you're drawn to, and your season. Just information for now.
reflect: When have you felt most alive serving God? What were you doing, and who was it for?
Which of your Fruitful areas surprised you, and which confirmed something you already sensed?
Is there anything you're doing right now mostly out of guilt? What would faithfulness, rather than guilt, ask of you?
report.nextReturn: Reopen this report any time from the link in your email, or retake it at thrive.loftcity.church
report.scripture: You are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for you to do. Ephesians 2:10
report.scriptureText: You are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for you to do.

decide.title: What would you like to do next?
decide.note: There's no wrong door. Filling this out doesn't mean you're signing up for anything.

try.s: One Sunday, no commitment past that.

talk.s: Learn more about a team, or think it through with Pastor Sam.

remind.s: Pick a time. We won't reach out before then.

keep.s: Nobody will reach out unless you ask.

decide.restFirst: You said this is a season of rest and healing. We've put the gentler doors first.

tryrole.title: Pick one to try
tryrole.note: Real roles, real time costs. Tap one and the team leader will text you about a first Sunday.

talk.title: Is there a team you'd like to learn more about?
talk.note: We'll email you and that team's leader together so you can ask anything. Pastor Sam will be copied.
talk.coffeeBody: If you're not sure whether this is a season for serving or a season for resting and healing, or where you'd fit if you did serve, Sam would love to sit down with you and think it through together. No agenda, no pressure.
talk.coffeeNo: Not right now, just keep my results

remind.title: When should we check in?
remind.note: We'll send one email on that day with your report and these same options. Nothing before then.
